title: Lighthouse daybook — prelaunch runnotes and follow-ups
content:
Quick context: prepping a soft launch for 'Lighthouse' (Hosted API improvements: adaptive batching + prefix cache). This is a personal scratchpad — messy. Aim: ship small rollout to 10% of new customers this week, validate latency and regression metrics, and have rollback paths ready.

Morning snapshot (2026-03-12):
- 08:30 standup notes: infra > autoscaler tuning pushed to staging; SRE to run warmup job at 10:00. Product: canary cohort defined (internal + onboarding customers). Growth: messaging draft for opt-in users ready.
- 09:10 smoke run with staging: 95th latency improved ~12% for short prompts (<=128 tokens). Longer sequences flaky — occasional timeouts at peak qps.
- 09:45 triage: timeout trace points to kernel selection fallback under quantized path. Filing follow-up with serving-runtime.

PRD edits to make (short):
- Update rollout section: add explicit 'circuit-breaker' threshold for percent error increase (default 3% over baseline sustained for 5m) and make it non-configurable for first 72 hours (safety).
- Clarify metric owners: latency SLO owner = eng/serving-runtime, quality regression owner = applied-ml, alert triage = SRE.
- Add required smoke-test matrix (short/long prompts, token-per-second distribution, embeddings throughput).

Immediate todos (today):
- [ ] Confirm warmup job schedule with infra (Ben) and get logs. (target: 10:00)
- [ ] Post rollback runbook snippet to #prod-launch Slack and pin. (done draft; need approvals)
- [ ] Send note to solutions-eng about enabling canary flag for pilot customers (Marisol).
- [ ] Add confluence link and ephemeral dashboard to launch doc.

Stakeholder follow-ups:
- Marisol Ortega (Solutions): ask which pilot customers want explicit notice vs silent opt-in. Deadline: EOD.
- Ben Wu (Infra): need verification that autoscaler change won't conflict with Dedicated pools. Ping if not confirmed by 11am.
- Diego Ramos (Applied ML): check eval set coverage for long-context prompts (>512 tokens). Missing sequences flagged — need quick augmentation.
- Legal (Lena K.): confirm that opt-in messaging is OK for EU customers (data processing blurb).

Risks / unknowns: 
- Long prompt flightiness: may need temporary cap on concurrent long-context sessions or fallback to non-quantized model variant.
- Billing impact: adaptive batching may group requests differently — ensure token-metering mapping still aligns with billing pipeline. Flagged to finance.
- Observability: current trace sampling doesn't capture prefix-cache hits; need short-term metric to expose cache-hit-rate per model shard.

Launch checklist (pre 10% rollout):
- [ ] End-to-end smoke tests green on staging (short + long + embeddings)
- [ ] Autoscaler warmup completed and validated
- [ ] Canary cohort list uploaded to admin console
- [ ] Slack runbook pinned + primary + secondary on-call listed
- [ ] Rollback toggle validated (quick toggle w/ infra + product)
- [ ] Billing sanity check (finance + instrumented logs for token grouping)
- [ ] Customer messaging copy approved for EU and US

Notes to self:
- Keep the first 24h heavy on monitoring — add 1-hour cadence checks for first 6h.
- If quality regression >1% (intent-level mismatch) open immediate rollback and set A/B split to 0 for the canary cohort.
- Document the exact GitHub PRs that changed quantization path (link below).

Quick snippets I want to copy into PRD (copy-ready):
- "Safety policy: automated circuit-breaker will disable Lighthouse adaptive batching for an affected region if error rate increases >3% relative to baseline for 5 continuous minutes. Operations team will be notified and can manually re-enable after investigation."
- "Metric ownership: latency SLO (p95) owned by eng/serving-runtime; quality regressions owned by applied-ml; billing/usage anomalies owned by finance ops."

Loose brainstorm (improvements post-launch):
- Small UI toggle in console to preview batching behavior for a route (simulate traffic mix).
- Expose cache-hit heatmap per model-version in Console (helpful for diagnosing cold cache effects).
- Auto-rollover: if a variant is rolled back twice in 24h, prevent auto-redeploys until manual approval.

Unresolved questions:
- Should we notify Dedicated customers differently? (some want opt-in gone through AE).
- How to reconcile batched-metering with existing invoice line items without causing disputes?

Linked quick links (for reference):
- Confluence (Lighthouse PRD draft): https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/PROD/Lighthouse+adaptive+batching+PRD
- Jira tickets: REQ-4721, SRE-1883, ML-9024
- GitHub PRs: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving-runtime/pull/981, https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/421
- Slack thread: https://redwood.slack.com/archives/C01ABCD2EFG/p1678472000000

End-of-day quick log (when I finish):
- what shipped vs blocked
- who I pinged and responses
- metrics snapshot (p50/p95/error-rate) — paste into ticket

Freeform capture (random):
- If we keep circuit-breaker at 3%, maybe add gradual backoff: 0% -> 2% -> 5% thresholds for different actions. Note to discuss with Diego.
- Reminder: re-run customer onboarding test with a real multi-turn chat example (not synthetic).

-- Aisha
